description_sq: Apartamenti ndodhet tek zona e 21 Dhjetori,pozicionohet ne katin e peste te nje ndertimi egzistues pa ashensor.Organizohet nga nje ambient ndenjeje sebashku me kendin e gatimit,dy dhoma gjumi nje tualet dhe nje ballkon.Orientimi mjaft i favorshem jug-lindje i mundeson ndricim natyral gjate dites.Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te regullt hipotekor dhe shitet bosh.Per me teper informacion na kontaktoni.
description_en: The apartment is located in the area of ​​21 Djetori, it is positioned on the fifth floor of an existing building without an elevator. It is organized by a living room with a kitchenette, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a balcony. The very favorable south-east orientation allows natural lighting during the day. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation and is sold empty. For more information, contact us.
